title: OntoKin immutable source and PNG bundle/0.2
$comment: C080 companion wire shape for the adopted textured-surfaces-0.1 contract. Runtime additionally enforces exact UTF-8 and complete-source bounds, valid semantic-version components, duplicate identities, canonical base64, exact image digests and byte limits. PNG semantics and declared closure are checked under admitted execution authority.

filename.description: Exact retained diagnostic label, never used for ambient file loading. The byte limit is 1024 UTF-8 bytes; spelling and Unicode normalization are preserved.

source.description: Exact source text encoded as UTF-8 without BOM stripping, Unicode normalization or newline changes. Total encoded bytes across all supplied units must not exceed 2,000,000.

version.description: Exact major.minor.patch; every decimal component is <=2147483647. Ranges, prerelease/build suffixes, whitespace and leading zeroes are not part of this profile.

data_base64.description: Canonical padded base64; exact decode/re-encode, digest and byte ceilings are checked by bundle sealing.

description: Exact source-unit and opaque-image transport. PNG semantics are checked later under admitted execution authority.
